package.description: Small Windows desktop app for planning Deep Rock Galactic class leveling.

en-US.description: Small Windows desktop app for planning Deep Rock Galactic class leveling.
en-US.longDescription: DRG XP Calculator is a small Windows desktop app for planning Deep Rock Galactic class leveling. It supports manual XP calculation from a class level and current XP, and can load a class's current progress directly from a DRG save file.
en-US.name: DRG XP Calculator
